chunks: And though We had given them Our signs they turned away from them.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people turn away from God's signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinction between divine provision of clear proofs (hujaj) and human agency in choosing to ignore them, reflecting the concept of 'tawqif' where guidance is offered but not forced. It serves as a theological reminder of human free will in rejecting guidance despite clear evidence.
